baseline_exposure: M1 saw all official train sequences during baseline training. This split protects the new candidate correction from sequence-level training overlap, but not parent pretraining exposure.
event_mining_rule_to_apply_after_baselin: First run of at least 3 consecutive valid frames with IoU < 0.5 and GT crop coverage >= 99.9%; use the first event per sequence and retain the immediately preceding frame. Separately record all valid-frame target/background evidence; do not select events by candidate improvement.

split_roles.calibration: Choose measurement definitions and debug extraction contracts only.
split_roles.development: Test one frozen causal hypothesis and choose at most one candidate version.
split_roles.locked_holdout: Evaluate the selected candidate once after all design choices are frozen.
